newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro stability pact a simple safeguard - Chirac.
newsitem.headline: Euro stability pact a simple safeguard - Chirac.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Thursday that the euro budgetary "stability pact" had evolved considerably since it was first proposed by German officials and should serve as a simple safeguard.
"The stability and growth pact has evolved during the course of European negotiations from the one originally envisaged by certain German technocrats," he said in a television interview.
"It will be what it should be, simply a safeguard to prevent those who are a bit lighthearted from allowing their currency to fall between the cracks in one country or another," Chirac said.

European Union leaders meet in Dublin on Friday and Saturday and finance ministers from the 15 EU countries were meeting on Thursday night to try to solve disagreements over a German-proposed pact on public deficit control in countries using the future euro single currency.
